1: Aey Rasool ﷺ! Jab Allah ki madad aap ke deen ke liye aa jaye aur woh us ko galib kar de, aur Makkah fatah ho jaye,
2: aur aap dekhein ke log giroh dar giroh Islam mein daakhil ho rahe hain,
3: to jaan lijiye ke yeh us kaam ke anjaam ko pahunchne ke qareeb hone ki nishani hai jis ke liye aap ko bheja gaya tha. Pas apne Rubb ki tasbeeh kijiye us ki tareef ke saath, taake aap madad aur fatah ki niyamaton par us ka shukr ada karein, aur us se magfirat maangiye, kyunke beshak wohi bakshne wala hai, jo apne bandon ki tauba qabool karta hai aur unhein maaf farmata hai.
